queries_preplanned: The specific legal standard and market definition used by the US District Court to determine Google's dominance in general web search, including the estimated market share percentage attributed to Google.
The list of specific anticompetitive practices cited by Judge Mehta as evidence of monopoly power, such as exclusive distribution agreements with Apple and Samsung.
The total annual payment amount from Apple to Google for being the default search engine on its devices, expressed in billions of dollars.
The number of major browser manufacturers or device makers that entered into exclusive default-search deals with Google between 2013 and 2020.
The specific structural remedies ordered by the court regarding the divestiture of Chrome browser assets if a fix-it-first approach fails.
The duration of the conduct remedy period imposed on Google's future business practices, measured in years.
